briefdescription.para: This function sends a command to ASUFW to perform ML-KEM encapsulation with the message m supplied by the caller instead of drawn from the TRNG, so that the ACVP encapsulation vectors can be driven through the module.

detaileddescription.para: FIPS 203 requires an approved ML-KEM.Encaps to draw m from an approved RBG, so only an ASUFW built with CAVP support serves this command; any other build rejects it as an invalid command. The encapsulation key must be passed by address, as the key vault is not available to this command.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XAsu_ClientParams structure which holds the client input parameters.
Pointer to the XAsu_MlkemEncapsDerandParams structure which holds the ML-KEM encapsulation parameters and the message m.

simplesect.para: Per FIPS 203, a ciphertext that does not match the decapsulation key yields a pseudorandom shared secret rather than an error, so that decapsulation gives an attacker no way to test ciphertexts. A successful decapsulation therefore does not mean the ciphertext was genuine. Callers must establish that through key confirmation on the derived shared secret, never by expecting a failure here.

briefdescription.para: This function sends a command to ASUFW to run the ML-KEM Known Answer Test, which encapsulates to and then decapsulates with a fixed NIST ACVP ML-KEM-512 vector on ASUFW and checks that the shared secrets match.

detaileddescription.para: Key generation is not part of it: it carries its own pairwise consistency test instead.
